title: Zesty Jamaican Coconut Curry
description: A floral, gooey, energizing Jamaican dish that blends coconut milk, fresh lime, and spice into a silky curry, sugar‑free and packed with flavor.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add minced ginger and sauté until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Stir in mixed spice and toast lightly for 1 minute.
Pour in diced tomatoes and coconut milk, bring to a gentle simmer.
Add tofu cubes and cook for 5 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
Stir in lime zest, scallions, salt, and pepper, simmer for another 3 minutes.
Pour in a tablespoon of cooled binchotan charcoal water and stir.
Remove from heat, let sit for 5 minutes to infuse the smoky aroma.
Serve hot over steamed rice or quinoa, garnish with extra scallions.
